summary: Built 12-item DAG for SkillSwap with hard/soft dependency classifications, starting points, and critical path analysis.
evidence: Grouped 22 requirements into 12 coherent work items (W01 to W12).
Constructed visual DAG with both Mermaid and ASCII representations in artifacts/dag-module-02.md.
Categorized 11 Hard dependencies vs 7 Soft dependencies.
Identified 3 starting points (W01, W02, W12) and 2 terminal leaf endpoints (W09, W10).
Computed critical path: W01/W02 -> W04 -> W06 -> W07 -> W11 (5 hops).
